paragraphs.source_zh: “世间一般人看来，神女就应生活在神社内庭，足不出户，一心供奉神灵。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed.”

units.source_en: “Indeed.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不错。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I intend to put that notion to practical use. Listen: these shrine maidens remain virgins forever, dancing in the hidden inner precinct and serving the gods. But when donations are sought to build the shrine's halls, they may display before the people the secret rites of the inner precinct handed down from ancient times. What do you think?”

units.source_en: “I intend to put that notion to practical use.
Listen: these shrine maidens remain virgins forever, dancing in the hidden inner precinct and serving the gods.
units.source_zh: 你听着，这些神女永远保持处子之身，在不为人知的内庭翩翩起舞，侍奉神灵。

units.source_en: But when donations are sought to build the shrine's halls, they may display before the people the secret rites of the inner precinct handed down from ancient times.
units.source_zh: 但是为修建神社殿堂而募集布施之时，则可令她们将远古流传下来的内庭祭祀时的秘技展示给大家。

units.source_en: What do you think?”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我要活用这想法。你听着，这些神女永远保持处子之身，在不为人知的内庭翩翩起舞，侍奉神灵。但是为修建神社殿堂而募集布施之时，则可令她们将远古流传下来的内庭祭祀时的秘技展示给大家。你认为如何？”

paragraphs.source_en: “The secret rites...”

units.source_en: “The secret rites...”

paragraphs.source_en: Hatarō stared wide-eyed, speechless. This was yet another of Nobuhide's audacious inspirations! He meant to reveal to the public sacred rites that had been conducted in secrecy for two thousand years; the world would surely be astonished. That alone was extraordinary enough; if he put the Three Sacred Treasures on public display, he might even say that the Son of Heaven would deliver an address. Everything Nobuhide did was closely bound to his own interests.

units.source_en: Hatarō stared wide-eyed, speechless.
This was yet another of Nobuhide's audacious inspirations!
units.source_zh: 这又是信秀大胆的奇想！

units.source_en: Everything Nobuhide did was closely bound to his own interests.
units.source_zh: 信秀的所有举动，都和他自己的利益密切相关。

paragraphs.source_zh: 波太郎瞪大了眼，无语。这又是信秀大胆的奇想！他竟然要将两千年以来一直秘密举行的神事公之于众，斯时定会让世人大吃一惊。这也罢了，他要是将三种神器公开，很可能会说出让天子致辞的话来。信秀的所有举动，都和他自己的利益密切相关。

paragraphs.source_en: Fine beads of sweat appeared on Hatarō's brow. Gritting his teeth, he asked, “What practical benefit will this bring my lord? I truly cannot imagine.”

paragraphs.source_en: “If I refuse this task, will my lord still give the women into my care?”

units.source_en: “If I refuse this task, will my lord still give the women into my care?”

paragraphs.source_en: Hatarō pondered in silence. Nobuhide actually intended to use the gods to gather information. Whether it was right or wrong, only he could have conceived such a thing.

paragraphs.source_en: Hatarō gave a slight nod.

paragraphs.source_en: Hatarō was about to take his leave. “Of late, I know nothing whatsoever of affairs within the castle.”
